newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PINTO GIVES BENFICA 1-0 WIN OVER SPORTING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PINTO GIVES BENFICA 1-0 WIN OVER SPORTING.

text.p: An early goal by Benfica captain Joao Pinto secured his team a 1-0 home victory over Sporting on Saturday to narrow the race for second place in the Portuguese first division.
Reigning champions Porto, who meet newly-promoted Espinho at home on Sunday, lead the table with 60 points while Sporting have 53 and Benfica 47.
Pinto scored in the 16th minute with a powerful left cross inside the box after a neat pass from recent Brazilian signing Valdir Morais, who was making his league debut.
Benfica's Belgian keeper Michel Preud-homme, who had been in doubt until the very last minute because of a serious stomach upset, made three excellent saves during the match.
Sporting, who had not lost for 12 games, seemed dogged by bad luck, hitting the bar once and the upright twice in the first half with shots by Pedro Barbosa and Bulgarian striker Ivaylo Iordanov.
They played the final 15 minutes with just 10 men after Barbosa was sent off for a foul on midfielder Tiago Pereira.
Sporting's Paulo Alves had an excellent chance to open the scoring in the third minute but his shot went wide.
In injury time Valdir almost extended Benfica's win when a pass from Joao Pinto left him alone in front of Sporting's Belgian keeper Filip De Wilde but he also shot wide.
